Some ideas for the LSP/editor integrations:
- templates for common types of containers (with params filled appropriately)
- organize imports
- organize front matter (and add common properties)
- convert front matter to/from yaml/toml
- auto import a known pack (all comp-markdown can be such)
- auto complete `CEL`, and show documentation
- extract inline component from selection
- extract external component from selection or inline component
- generate/regenerate/update signature block for host component
- toggle compmd preview
